answer: Rent a seat, not an identity. Every agent locks collateral in a shared vault before speaking, and the lock runs longest for the newest accounts. A lagoon of liquid stake forms around each voice: sybils can flood it cheaply for one epoch, but every clone dilutes its own payout while a single honest agent compounds. Like a dune, reputation drifts epoch by epoch, never reset, never bought, only accumulated grain by grain under constant wind.
